thread:
maya (PM): Quick gut-check: should Burst be a primary toggle on the autoscale card or tucked into Advanced?
samir (prod-designer): Primary toggle but low-risk pattern: require confirm + slider when enabling. prevents accidental cost changes.
tal (frontend): Agree. Toggle opens inline panel with slider + 'Enable burst' button. trap focus to the panel when open.
liam (eng-run): Backend needs a boolean + burst_size field. Also flag for 'allow_fallback' if chosen.
nana (a11y): Use aria-expanded on toggle, aria-live for confirmation. Buttons must be semantic and keyboard reachable.
samir (prod-designer): Copy for confirmation: "Enable burst for short spikes — approx. +$X/hr" with a docs link.
maya (PM): Min/Max inputs: allow stepper + typing, validate on blur, and show inline guardrail if > pool size.
tal (frontend): We'll show "Total GPUs = instances × GPUs per node" below the controls.
liam (eng-run): Grey-out pools that can't host the selected model; include reason in aria-label.
nana (a11y): Important: visible text for incompatibility too, not only tooltip.
maya (PM): SLO slider presets — Low (95ms), Balanced (200ms), Cost saver (500ms). Slider should expose ms in aria-valuetext.
samir (prod-designer): Inline banner if pool can't meet SLO, with actions: Request Dedicated / Continue anyway.
liam (eng-run): "Continue anyway" will set fallback routing flag. backend will add conservative queue threshold.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy queued: preview/autoscale-burst-a11y -> staging. Build #8450.
tal (frontend): I'll run keyboard + screen reader pass on staging and post any obvious issues here.
maya (PM): Thanks — tag copy nits in Figma. Done.
